snippet.description:
Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are in beta today. Ask Claude to turn your data into live dashboards and your ideas into animated explainers.

Claude Dashboards connects to your data platform or CRM and builds dashboards that update as your data changes. In beta on all paid plans.

Claude writes each one as code, with no video model involved, so you can change any word, number, or timing, then export an MP4 or open it in your video editor. In beta on Team and Enterprise plans.

And starting today, Claude Docs, Claude Slides, and Claude Design are out of beta and available on every plan including Free.

snippet.title: I Built an Entire Social Media Team With 0 Employees #shorts #claude #automatedsystem #aiagent #ai
snippet.description:
This is an AI social media team built for a one-person company with zero employees.

It handles everything: research, content, posting, and reporting. But nothing goes public until you sign off on it.

Module 1, Research. Claude digs into your niche like a full-time strategist would. What is trending this week, which competitor posts just blew up, and what your audience keeps asking in the comments. Then it pulls the top videos on your topic and lines up their hooks side by side: what they said in the first three seconds, and why it worked.

Module 2, Content. All that research turns into a full week of content. Short videos, carousels, captions, all in your voice. Every video opens with a hook built on what is already working, but made for you, not copied from someone else. And every post sits in an approval queue until you hit approve.

Module 3, Posting and Community. Once you approve a post, it goes out on every platform at the right time. Comments get replies, DMs get answered, and anyone who asks "how much?" gets flagged as a lead instead of getting lost in your inbox.

And running the whole thing? Claude Code. It tracks the money, not just the likes. Which posts brought in new followers, who clicked your link, and which clicks actually turned into paying customers. Then every morning, it sends you a one-page summary.

One person. Zero employees. A full social media team.

snippet.title: What Is Grok Bot? Grok Bot vs ChatGPT & Claude Explained #GrokBot #Grok #AIAgents #AI
snippet.description:
What is Grok Bot, and is it really different from ChatGPT or Claude? Here's Grok Bot explained simply, for beginners.

Instead of one AI chatbot, xAI's Grok Bot lets you set up a team of AI workers ("Bots"), each with its own job. They can talk to each other, hand work off, and use websites and apps on a shared cloud computer. You can even teach a Bot a task by doing the steps once while it watches.

But ChatGPT and Claude can already do much more than answer questions. They're becoming AI agents too. So the bigger question may not be which AI is best. It may be: how much work are you comfortable handing over to AI?

In this Short:
- What Grok Bot is and how Grok Bots work together
- Teaching a Bot a task by showing it
- Grok Bot vs ChatGPT and Claude: what's actually different

Grok Bot is in beta. Availability and pricing vary by plan and may change. This information is current as of September 2026.

Sources (xAI):
- Introducing Grok Bot: https://x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot
- Grok Bot documentation: https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/overview

Would you hand real work to an AI team? Let me know in the comments.

This is AI Uncomplicated, and it is just that simple.

snippet.title: Screenshot to Code Clones Any Website for Free
snippet.description:
Comment "CLONE" to get this tool.

There's a free open-source project on GitHub turning screenshots of any website into real working code. Tens of thousands of stars.

Upload a screenshot of any site and it reads the layout and spacing, then outputs editable React, Vue, or plain HTML.

Go to screenshottocode.com. Click the Upload button to drop in a screenshot, or hit Screen Record and click through a site yourself. Choose your output framework and which AI model to use: Claude, Gemini, or GPT. Hit Generate.

The recording mode reads every click and hover interaction and turns it into a working prototype.

You can also drop in a Figma file and it rebuilds that the same way.

It works not only with screenshots but also with Figma designs, reference images, and screen recordings. The output is a live, editable website prototype ready for customization. This innovation simplifies web development workflows and accelerates prototyping, making design-to-code conversion accessible for developers and designers alike. #AI #WebDevelopment #OpenSource

snippet.title: Screenshot to Code: Turn Any Website Into Code (Open Source)
snippet.description:
One screenshot in, the whole website back as working code 🖥️

Screenshot to Code is open source and you can self-host it. It reads layout, spacing, fonts and colors and rebuilds the page. Works from Figma and screen recordings too.
